_doc: Floodgate Stadium: concrete with a shallows channel down the middle and two narrow bridges across it. Tide fighters own the channel (Culvert wades it at full speed; Flop Dash and Slush Slide run faster through it); everyone else crosses at the bridges or slows down. Rects are [col, row, width, height] in 8 px cells on the 84x36 grid.
name: Floodgate Stadium

light._doc: evening floodlights from the top right, over the wet concrete

ambient._doc: spray over the channel, dragonflies and a jumping fish in the shallows; see AmbientView
